simple.summary: לְחֵנָה (lᵉchênâh) means a concubine First listed occurrence: Dan 5 2.

definitions.full: H3904. lechenah [ לְחֵנָה ] noun feminine concubine ( לְחֵינְתָא ᵑ7 ; Fl Levy NHWB ii. 534 f. compare Arabic , indelicate epithet for woman; Batten Ezra 2:65 compare Arabic note, tune, song ; still otherwise Wetzst De, HL u. Koh. 454 ); — plural suffix לְחֵנָתָךְ Dan 5:23 , הֵּ֯ 5:2 ; 5:3 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from an unused root of uncertain meaning;
